description: Run a fresh AgentReady audit of an e-commerce store (~30s, public pages only, no order placed) and return the same readiness summary as check_merchant_readiness plus a public report link. Use it when check_merchant_readiness says the host has no scan, or the user wants a re-measure. Rate-limited per caller and globally.

url.description: Store URL or hostname, e.g. shop.example.com (a product page URL also works)

vertical.description: Optional store vertical for the benchmark: general, dtc_fashion, supplements, specialty_coffee, beauty or home_living (default general)

name: scan_store
